import random
seed = int(input())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 5)
m = rng.randint(1, 5)
k = rng.randint(0, 2)
p = rng.choice([0.2, 0.35, 0.5])
rows = []
for r in range(n):
    rows.append(''.join('#' if rng.random() < p else '.' for _ in range(m)))
rows[0] = '.' + rows[0][1:]
rows[n - 1] = rows[n - 1][:m - 1] + '.'
print(n, m, k)
print('\n'.join(rows))
